outcome: postoperative changes in hemoglobin and platelets
cohort: Morbidly obese women (BMI of 40 or greater) who underwent cesarean delivery
finding: Weight-based enoxaparin dosing was significantly more effective than BMI-stratified dosing in achieving adequate anti-Xa concentrations for venous thromboembolism prophylaxis in morbidly obese women after cesarean delivery.
